title: Colonial Pipeline
subtitle: Ransomware & precautionary operational shutdown

provenance.title: Colonial Pipeline cyber incident
provenance.summary: Colonial shut its pipeline on 7 May 2021 after ransomware. DOE records emergency transport measures on 9 May and the announcement of full-system restart and deliveries to all markets on 13 May.
provenance.rights: Original paraphrase and source link only. Third-party testimony and embedded materials are not assumed openly licensed.
provenance.transformation: Curated factual summary; day precision retained; source publication and event dates kept separate.

provenance.title: Colonial Pipeline outage affects gasoline supply
provenance.summary: EIA describes a roughly 5,500-mile petroleum-products system from Houston to Linden. Mainlines remained stopped on 10 May, while smaller lines operated. Shipment transit means restart does not immediately replenish every market.
provenance.rights: Original paraphrase and source link only. Third-party testimony and embedded materials are not assumed openly licensed.
provenance.transformation: Curated factual summary; day precision retained; source publication and event dates kept separate.

evidence.summary: Colonial shut its pipeline on 7 May 2021 after ransomware. DOE records emergency transport measures on 9 May and the announcement of full-system restart and deliveries to all markets on 13 May.

claims.text: Colonial shut its pipeline on 7 May after a ransomware attack.
claims.limitation: Reported shutdown, not a measured flow series. Exact start time is not established here.

claims.text: Federal emergency transport measures began on 9 May.
claims.limitation: Response measures do not establish a geographic outage footprint.

claims.text: The FBI attributed the network compromise to DarkSide ransomware on 10 May.
claims.limitation: Official attribution is reported, not independently reproduced by this application.

claims.text: On 13 May, Colonial announced full-system restart and deliveries to all markets.
claims.limitation: Restart does not mean immediate replenishment of every station or recovery of all downstream impacts.

claims.text: Business IT detection led to a precautionary operational shutdown, according to the CEO.
claims.limitation: Retrospective 8 June testimony. Do not interpret the shutdown as proof of direct control-system compromise.

claims.text: EIA describes the system as connecting Houston, Texas, with Linden, New Jersey.
claims.limitation: Service geography only. No pipeline alignment or affected-area polygon is supplied.

claims.text: The reviewed bundle does not establish a measured outage footprint or prove direct operational-technology compromise.
claims.limitation: Absence of confirmation is not proof of absence; the CEO described an ongoing investigation.
